title: AU Living Condo Rental Prototype Report
description: A student housing service concept with a Figma prototype for rental listings and a tabletop model of an information hub.

sections.title: Project Overview
paragraphs: AU Living was a team project presented at Assumption University in February 2025. Its objective was to help students find condos near campus by combining a rental listings website with access to in-person assistance.

sections.title: Student Feedback and Design Requirements
paragraphs: The team surveyed 51 students. High rental costs were the most frequently selected concern, at 39.2%. Students also identified difficulties contacting landlords, finding available units, and understanding lease terms.
The design prioritized visible starting rents, listings that students could compare in one place, and access to assistance with availability and lease questions.

sections.title: Digital Prototype
paragraphs: The Figma prototype opens on the property listings page. Each sample listing includes a photo, a short description, the starting rent, and a link to the property details. Students can also filter listings and open the hub page.
The accompanying storyboard outlines a rental search from filtering and shortlisting to contacting landlords and visiting properties.

sections.title: Physical Miniature Prototype
paragraphs: The tabletop model shows the proposed information hub with a reception desk, computer stations, lounge seating, and meeting tables. A student could review a shortlist at a computer station and meet with an assistant to discuss a property’s availability, fees, or lease terms.

figures.alt: AU Living’s tabletop miniature with a reception desk, small computer stations, blue lounge seats, consultation tables, and a display board about the rental service.
figures.caption: AU Living’s physical model, showing the reception desk, listing stations, and meeting areas.

sections.title: Project Contribution
paragraphs: My part of the pitch covered what students needed from a rental service, including affordable options near campus, trustworthy listings, clear lease terms, and timely responses from property managers.

sections.title: Outcome and Proposed Next Steps
paragraphs: The prototypes demonstrated a proposed handoff between online search and in-person assistance. The pitch identified listing verification and tools for landlords to manage their posts as possible additions. The team also proposed exploring a partnership with the university dormitory.
